honest.title: Honest reading
honest.description: The meter reports exactly what it measured for the latest daylight hour.
honest.defence: Should be ACCEPTED and minted as a certificate.

inflated.title: Inflated reading
inflated.description: The meter's own key signs 2.2× the energy it really produced.
inflated.defence: AI verifier: claim far above what satellite irradiance allows.

cloud_fake.title: Sunshine that wasn't there
cloud_fake.description: Claims full midday output for an hour when clouds or a low sun made that impossible.
cloud_fake.defence: AI verifier: independent irradiance and solar geometry contradict the claim.

night.title: Generation at night
night.description: Claims 30% of nameplate output for an hour when the sun was below the horizon.
night.defence: Physics hard limit: solar geometry says zero is possible.

tampered.title: Tampered in transit
tampered.description: An honest signed reading is intercepted and its energy value raised 1.8×.
tampered.defence: Signature check: the meter never signed the altered value.

forged.title: Forged meter identity
forged.description: Attacker signs a reading with their own key but claims to be the campus meter.
forged.defence: Signature check: signer is not the registered meter key.

unregistered.title: Rogue meter
unregistered.description: A brand-new, never-registered device submits a perfectly signed reading.
unregistered.defence: On-chain device registry: only registered, active meters count.

replay.title: Replay / double issuance
replay.description: Resubmits a reading that was already certified, hoping to mint it twice.
replay.defence: Smart contract: one certificate per meter-hour, ever.
